correctness.rationale: For finite-dimensional F^d, GL_d-orbits of ordered pairs (U,V) are determined by (dim U,dim V,dim U∩V). Etingof et al. D4 injective-arm triple-subspace decomposition is direct sums of eight 1D membership patterns and one diagonal 2D pattern over any field. For an arbitrary third-pebble move, transfer the complete triple pattern over the other field then align the surviving pair using GL_d. This preserves every atomic equality and inclusion relation and the pair profile without a diminishing rank parameter, so yields unrestricted-round noncounting three-pebble equivalence. Strict-chain height is definable with two reusable variables and separates d≠e. Four mutually incomparable lines in F_3^2 but only three in F_2^2 separate at width four. Independent span-generated enumeration of ALL subspaces over F_2 and F_3 in dimensions 2 and 3 reproduced identical two-pebble pair-profile/third-extension supports (5 vs 6 subspaces in d2, 16 vs 28 in d3); finite check corroborates, not proves all dimensions/fields.
